ideas.pitch: A multilingual value-based education and ethics storytelling platform inspired by Swami Vivekananda's teachings, delivering interactive ethical dilemmas and leadership scenarios to rural and urban school children via mobile web.
ideas.title: VivekaValues AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the values and vision of the co-organizer, the Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Institute of Values, appealing directly to the cultural and educational ethos of the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A civic tech dashboard and reporting mobile application that uses computer vision to detect garbage hotspots, overflowing bins, and pollution sources across Delhi, automatically routing reports to local municipal authorities.
ideas.title: DelhiClean AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses pressing real-world environmental challenges in Delhi with a demonstrable, working prototype and clear measurable impact on civic cleanliness.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first vernacular AI teaching assistant designed for resource-constrained community schools, helping volunteer educators generate lesson plans and quizzes based on national curriculum standards in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: GuruShikshak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact social welfare and education democratization, following proven winning patterns of impactful civic and community tools.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first regional language AI companion for elderly citizens in India that screens incoming phone calls and SMS for financial fraud and scam patterns, alerting both the senior and their designated family members.
ideas.title: ElderSahayak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a deeply personal and urgent safety issue with advanced voice agents, echoing successful agentic hackathon entries that protect vulnerable populations.

ideas.pitch: A campus-to-community micro-volunteering and skill-matching platform that connects engineering students from DTU and technical institutes across India with local NGOs and community centers needing digital literacy and technical infrastructure help.
ideas.title: SkillSetu DTU
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the institutional context of DTU and national collaboration goals, showcasing a working local ecosystem dashboard that judges can test live during the event.
